title: Trusting the Plan
paragraphs: Rizal applied for a job he really wanted, but after two rounds of interviews, he did not get it. He felt disappointed for several days and struggled to understand why things did not go his way.

A close friend reminded him that Allah's plan is often wiser than any single plan a person makes for himself. Rizal decided to keep applying elsewhere, without losing hope, while doing his part fully each time.

Some weeks felt discouraging, especially when two more applications also ended without an offer. Still, he kept preparing carefully for every interview, reminding himself that effort was his responsibility, while the outcome belonged to Allah alone.

Three months later, Rizal found a role that suited him even better than the first one. Looking back, he understood that trusting Allah's timing, while still working hard, is very different from simply giving up.
